newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest says to bid for Food Terminal.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest says to bid for Food Terminal.

text.p: Holding company Filinvest Development Corp said on Wednesday its board had decided to participate in the privatisation of a 121-hectare agro-industrial complex in suburban Manila.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange the decision was made at a special board meeting held on Tuesday. The bidding for the privatisation is scheduled for next Wednesday.
The government is selling 51 percent of Food Terminal Inc for at least 6.967 billion pesos.
Filinvest Development is developing a 244-hectare lot in Alabang, south of Manila, and a 214-hectare lot in Fort Bonifacio, located at the edge of Manila's Makati business district.
Other prequalified bidders include a consortium led by Metro Pacific Corp ; SM Prime Holdings and Keppel Land Ltd of Singapore; and a group led by local firm College Assurance Plan.
